audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the chart gives Cassiopeia 5 of 7 stages while Diana wins 54.95% over 657 games.
audit.why: The kit supports a hard early lane for Diana (850-range Q on a 3.5s cooldown, Miasma grounding the dash) and a Diana flip at 6, so the shape is defensible even if the totals look inverted against the win rate.
audit.corrected: Kept the content-layer verdicts as-is and aligned the stale full layer to them; flagged the win-rate-vs-chart conflict for the user rather than inventing a resolution.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five full-layer phases[N].side rows read 'Skill' while win[N] read Cassiopeia/Diana, and the phases[N].why sentences all described Diana winning even on stages the content layer awards Cassiopeia.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row; the page was rendering two answers, and the whys argued against the verdict.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to win[N] and each affected why rewritten to match the new verdict, grounded in Noxious Blast's 3.5s cooldown, Miasma's 24/22/20/18/16 grounding and Twin Fang's 0.75s heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grounding was repeatedly attributed to Cassiopeia's Q. It is Miasma (W). content.early also called Diana's dash 'your Q's mobility' — the dash is Lunar Rush (E). breakdown.cooldowns carried no number, and two bullets were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Riot text: Noxious Blast (Q) poisons and grants Cassiopeia move speed; Miasma (W) slows and grounds, and grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities. Diana's dash is E, 22/20/18/16/14, refunded only onto a Moonlight target.
audit.corrected: Grounding attributed to Miasma (W) everywhere, dash named as Lunar Rush (E), real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia off every poisoned tick and no field named Grievous Wounds by item.
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that heals a percentage of damage dealt to poisoned targets, so extended trades are decided by anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names Oblivion Orb early and states why.

edits.before: This is one of the few mid matchups where you're on the back foot from level 1 — Cassiopeia's Noxious Blast poke range and Twin Fang damage both outclass your kit before you have items or a full combo online. She grounds you if you dash into her Q cloud, which shuts down your Q's mobility entirely, so respect that zone.
